note: Mutants of the list of reverse proxies that the web image ships (docker/trusted-proxies.conf), of the places where docker/nginx.conf includes it and of the way the stack files and the image carry it, for tools/mutate.py (docs/WORKFLOW.md, 'Mutation checks'). Run from the checkout with the program nginx installed: python3 tools/mutate.py tests/data/trusted_proxies_mutants.json --keep-going --jobs 1. Every mutant must be caught by tests/scripts/test_nginx_trusted_proxies.py: each breaks one rule - only the private and internal ranges are believed (not one of them missing, none widened, none for everybody), the header is X-Forwarded-For and it is read from the right, the list is the site's default and the operator's folder replaces it, a zone and a door get the address nginx settled on and never a header, the stacks mount the operator's file by a full path with /dev/null as the default, into the folder that nginx includes, and the image has the list. The mutants change one file each and put it back.
